results.description:
UTM lets you run Windows® 11, Ubuntu®, or macOS(*) fully virtualized with maximum performance. Run Windows® 7, Windows® XP, and other older operating system emulated with decent performance.

UTM uses the popular QEMU system emulator securely in a sandboxed environment to protect your data from viruses and malware in the emulated operating system.

Designed for macOS using the latest and greatest Apple technologies, UTM is built from the ground up with the Mac in mind.

Features:

 • Run ARM64 operating systems such as Windows® for ARM and Ubuntu® ARM on your Apple Silicon Mac fully virtualized at near native speeds
 • Run Intel/AMD operating system such as Windows® 7, Windows® XP, Ubuntu® Linux, and more (emulated with limited performance on Apple Silicon Macs, fully virtualized on Intel Macs)
 • Run macOS 12 or higher in a virtualized environment(*)
 • Run Intel applications on Linux with Rosetta(**)
 • Over 30 processors can be emulated by the QEMU backend including i386, x64, ARM32, ARM64, MIPS, PPC, and RISC-V for developers and enthusiasts
 • Supports macOS Sandbox to protect your data from any viruses or malware infecting the emulated operating system (such as Windows®)
 • GUI display mode, terminal console mode, and headless mode (with support for multiple displays)
 • Attach USB devices to your virtual machine
 • Experimental: GPU accelerated OpenGL on Linux VMs
 • Bridged and shared networking support
 • Run and store VMs from external drives
 • Don't know how to use QEMU? Confused at all the options QEMU provides? UTM provides an easy to understand UI for creating and configuring VMs that does not require knowledge of QEMU command line arguments

Current Limitations:

We are working hard to provide new features. Below are some things currently missing from UTM. We hope to support at least some of these features in the future.

 • No direct mounting of external disks and drives, only mounting disk images is supported
 • No drag & drop of files and data, only copy paste of text and sharing of a single directory is supported with tools installed
 • No GPU acceleration for Windows® and only experimental OpenGL acceleration for Linux (most Windows® games will NOT run)
 • macOS virtualization only runs on Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 12 and up. macOS 12 does not support USB sharing, copy/paste, or dynamic resolution.

(*) macOS virtualization is only supported on Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 12 and up.
(**) Linux with Rosetta is only supported on Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 13 and up.

results.description:
O Parallels Desktop permite que você execute o Windows e outros sistemas operacionais no Mac sem problemas.
Com o Parallels Desktop, você obtém as vantagens do macOS, do Windows e do Linux na mesma máquina física.
Como o primeiro parceiro autorizado pela Microsoft a executar o Windows em um Mac com silício da Apple, o Parallels Desktop for Mac oferece a solução ideal para executar o Windows 11 em seu Mac com silício da Apple.

Nossa App Store Edition é executada em uma área restrita. Há diferenças entre o Parallels Desktop App Store e as edições Standard e Pro. Saiba mais sobre as diferenças: https://kb.parallels.com/123796.

Experimente nosso Parallels Desktop App Store Edition gratuitamente com uma avaliação de 14 dias. Role até as compras no aplicativo para ver os preços.

Com a confiança de mais de 7 milhões de usuários de Mac em todo o mundo.

---

AVISO DE ISENÇÃO DE RESPONSABILIDADE: Não recomendamos que os usuários existentes do Parallels Desktop para Mac migrem para o Parallels Desktop App Store Edition.

---

Eleito o melhor aplicativo para executar Windows no Mac pela Escolha do leitor da About.com.

PCMag: “[...] melhor e mais rápido software de emulação para executar o Windows, o Linux e até versões mais antigas do macOS em Macs baseados em processador Intel.”

---

PRINCIPAIS RECURSOS

- Jogue centenas de jogos populares para Windows, como Assassin's Creed, Age of Empires, Minecraft, Fall Guys, Rocket League e Half-Life 2 (aplicam-se limitações)

- Execute o Windows 11 no Arm Pro e Enterprise via Apple Silicon em seu Mac. 

- Acesse aplicativos para Windows, como Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, Access), AutoCAD, SOLIDWORKS, Revit, QuickBooks, Power BI, Visual Studio, Quicken, Visio, Adobe Acrobat, Docker, Steam e muito mais.

- Suporte para Macs baseados em Intel e ARM e para as versões mais recentes do macOS e do Windows.

- Ajuste os recursos alocados à máquina virtual (VM), como CPU, GPU e RAM, para otimizar o desempenho.

- Em um Mac com processador Intel, você pode executar a maioria das versões do Windows, Linux e macOS.

- Em um Mac com silício da Apple, você pode executar as versões Arm do Windows 11 Pro, Ubuntu Linux, Fedora Workstation, Debian GNU/Linux, Kali Linux e muito mais

--

Com o Parallels Desktop, você pode experimentar o Windows como se ele tivesse sido projetado para Mac. Faça o download hoje mesmo e comece a executar o Linux e os aplicativos para Windows em seu Mac! 

Sistemas operacionais compatíveis:

- Em um Mac com um processador Intel, é possível executar a maioria das versões do Windows, do Linux e do macOS;
- Em um Mac com chip Apple Silicon, incluindo os modelos mais recentes M5 e MacBook Neo, os seguintes sistemas operacionais (apenas baseados em ARM) são compatíveis para execução em uma máquina virtual.
· Edições do Windows 11 Pro e Enterprise (recomendado)
· Ubuntu Linux 24.04, 23.04, 22.04, 21.10, 21.04, 20.10, 20.04
· Fedora Workstation 40, 39
· Debian GNU/Linux 12, 11
· Kali Linux 2024.2, 2023.1, 2022.2, 2022.1, 2021.3
· Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) 9
· macOS Monterey 12
· macOS Ventura 13
· macOS Sonoma 14
· macOS Sequoia 15

Veja a lista completa de sistemas operacionais compatíveis e requisitos de sistema em https://kb.parallels.com/123800

---

Sobre a Parallels:

O Parallels Desktop é um poderoso aplicativo de área de trabalho virtual para Mac que permite aos usuários executar sistemas operacionais e aplicativos Windows, Linux e OS X em seus Macs com chips Intel ou Apple série M. O Parallels Desktop torna isso possível por meio da virtualização de áreas de trabalho, utilizando tecnologia de software para criar uma máquina virtual (VM). Esta VM funciona como um PC virtual dentro do seu Mac, permitindo que os usuários instalem e operem sistemas operacionais da mesma forma que fariam em um computador físico.

Se você gosta de usar o Parallels Desktop ou tem uma ideia que gostaria de compartilhar conosco, deixe um comentário

results.description:
Run a virtual macOS machine on your Apple Silicon computer.

On first start, the latest macOS restore image can be downloaded from Apple servers. After installation has finished, you can start using the virtual machine by performing the initial operating system (OS) setup.

You can configure the following virtual machine parameters:
- CPU count
- RAM
- Shared folder
- Audio input
- Network type (Network Address Translation/NAT or Bridge)

Other new features:
- Create snapshots to revert to previous versions of your VM (requires macOS 27)
- Disk images are smaller now and only take up the actually used size (requires macOS 27)
- Automatic VM provisioning: enter username, password and other settings when creating the VM, the VM is then automatically set up (requires macOS 27)
- USB pass-through: Attach USB devices to the VM (requires macOS 27)
- Run multiple VMs at once
- Autostart: select a VM that will be started when virtualOS is opened
- You can configure the location where VM files are stored in the app settings to use external USB disks

Unlike other apps on the AppStore, no In-App purchases are required for managing multiple virtual machines, setting CPU count or the amount of RAM.

This application is free and open source software, source code is available at: https://github.com/yep/virtualOS

results.description:
VMTek is the Mac virtualization platform you've been waiting for. Run multiple instances and versions of macOS*, Linux and other operating systems side-by-side on your Mac with ease. High performance Mac-native virtualization designed from the ground up to take advantage of the latest macOS features and allow you to focus on getting work done - provisioning a new virtual machine with the OS of your choice takes just a few simple clicks. A streamlined, Mac-centric user interface makes the experience of working with VMTek virtual machines a joy.

Note: The free trial is not a subscription and we do not do any subscriptions. You will not be charged anything after the free trial. If you like VMTek, please supports its development by purchasing a license.

Enjoy these great VMTek features:

- great performance
- easy provisioning with automatic guest downloads
- support for the latest virtualization standards
- suspend & resume support
- snapshots support with a fully graphical tree-based snapshot manager
- file sharing with the guest
- Mac trackpad support
- NAT and bridged networking support, multiple adapters
- multiple fixed and removable disks, managed disks
- native Retina display support, automatic resizing
- hardware accelerated graphics on macOS guests with buttery smooth performance
- audio playback and microphone support
- VM cloning - online & offline
- keyboard shortcuts support
- copy and paste integration
- automated installation of macOS guests
- more in the works!

* Note: macOS guests require an Apple Silicon Mac. MacOS 12 and later guests supported. Windows guests are not yet supported.
